RichBinaryReader_Stream::Open -- BluelAPI RichBinary block-structured serialization (player saves saves\player%i.rb, editor data). File header = 0x17 bytes: "RICHBINARY"(10) + NUL + version(1) + u32 payload-start + total-file-size. mismatch magic -> "<file> is not a valid RichBinary file." (Reader_Stream.cpp:0x14) mismatch size -> "wrong length. Expected N ... actual M" (Reader_Stream.cpp:0x1b) then Seek(0x17) and read the body. Block header = one LE u32 (split in RichBinaryReader::NextBlock): bits 0..28 (0x1FFFFFFF) = payload size in bytes bits 29..30 (0x60000000) = type: 0 container, 0x20 kind7, 0x40 kind9, 0x60 kind10 bit 31 (0x80000000) = has-name / leaf flag Nesting via a runtime stack (reader[0x46] depth, reader[6+i] = end offset of open block i). Writer reserves the 4-byte header and RichBinaryWriter::EndContainer seeks back to store (finalPos - 4 - hdrPos) -- sizes are always back-patched. Names are numeric tag ids via a global type registry (DAT_004ff40c / count DAT_004ff410): RichBinaryTypeRegistry::FindByTag / FindByName (ci). Array elements use "<name> (%d)". Strings serialize as [u16 len][len bytes], each byte through RichBinary::ScrambleChar. Text variants (Reader_Text / Writer_Text) are std::iostream-based over the same tag stream.

LevelManager::LoadLevelDefs -- parses the plain-text directive file data\resdefs\thegame.lev (loaded from GameSession::Init; ";" = comment; fail -> "ERROR: Couldn't load level definitions file."). Directives: menumusic:<path> -> LevelManager+0x00; level:<id> -> new TLevelInfo(0x28), append, assign sequential index (+0x18), playable flag +0x14=1, and +0x00 = <id> = THE <id>.bsp world-file base name; rrf:<name> -> +0x08 = "data\resdefs\"+name (per-level ROC resource-def); title:"<text>" -> +0x04 (display title); music:<name> -> +0x0c; time:<minutes> -> +0x10 stored as SECONDS (value*60, default 1200.0); mapcoords:<x>,<y> -> +0x20/+0x24 (campaign-map pin). GameSession::LoadLevel then does String(TLevelInfo+0x00)+".bsp" -> FUN_00471310 and ROCResourceParser::ParseFile(TLevelInfo+0x08). NOTE: there is NO per-level difficulty-scale field (the earlier "idx 0/1 x1.5, idx 2 x1.0" note is unconfirmed/likely wrong -- difficulty is only the per-profile TPlayerInfo+0x2c byte). TLevelInfo+0x1c (-1 default) is unidentified.

TPlayerInfo::ResetRunStatsSchema -- PlayerStats::Clear(this+0x30) then PlayerStats::RegisterStat once per key. The stat schema is CODE-REGISTERED, not file-loaded. 13 keys, in records-screen display order (type / submitRule +0x14 / init / mergeRule +0x18): Completion Time (time/overwrite/0/min); Bonus Points (int/-/0/max); Rescues (int/-/0/max); Shortest Rescue Time (time/keep-min/999999999/min); Longest Rescue Time (time/keep-max/0/min); Axe Hits (int/-/0/max); Gallons Sprayed (volume/-/0/max); Objects Thrown; Air Time (time); Fires Doused; Serious Burns; Jumps; Total Steps. Node layout: +0x10 type (0 int / 1 time mm:ss / 2 volume), +0x14 submit rule (SubmitStat: 0 overwrite / 1 keep-min / 2 keep-max), +0x18 merge rule (MergeFrom: 0 min / 1 max / 2 overwrite), +0x1c name String, +0x20 displayIndex, +0x24 value (AddStat +=), +0x28 secondary counter (IncStat ++). Live run map = TPlayerInfo+0x30; per-level best = TLevelScore+0x08.

Inside GameSession::SetAudioState(state, name) -- the 7-state music/mute machine. 0 = enter menu (pause game music +0x690, unpause menu music +0x698, mute cats 1&2). 1 = resume gameplay (reverse + ResumeAllChannels). 2 = start level: load "Data\snd\music\"+name into +0x694, play looped into +0x690, ResumeAllChannels, unmute, SetSfxVolume, FlushDeferredPlays. 3 = leave level: stop+free game music, mute cat 2, StopAllChannels. 4 = enter interior: set muffled flag GameSession+0x6a8, cat 2 x0.3. 5 = exit interior: clear muffled, restore cats 1&2. 6 = start menu music into +0x698 from name +0x6ac. Music is an ordinary TSoundSample (streams only if the filename ends .mp3). SetMusicVolume pauses/unpauses the active slot (selector byte GameSession+0x64c) as volume crosses 0.1.

GameSession::LoadLevel(GameSession* this, TLevelInfo* pLI) -- main\evergame.cpp ~245. THE menu-side level start (synchronous). Called from MenuScreen_Title::OnButtonActivate id 0 ("Begin Mission"), after LevelManager::FindByIndex maps the selection index -> TLevelInfo* and MenuManager::TeardownToLoading draws the loading screen. Steps: - trace banner "\n\n!!-- TEverGame: Loading level \"<name>\" --!!" - *(this+0x688) = pLI (set current TLevelInfo*, written twice) - this+0x6f0 = 2 (state=loading); later this+0x6ec = 0 - ROCResourceParser::ParseFile(*(pLI+8)+0xc) -- parse the level ROC resdef (.rrf) - String + ".bsp" -> FUN_00471310(path, 1) -- LOAD THE BSP WORLD - build EntityCreateStruct "World" (type 0x2711), set userdata, flush the entity spawn queue -> World entity - restore category volumes, SoundWrap::ApplyVolume The in-game path GameSession::RequestLevelChange (0x0042a260) is the DEFERRED version: it only sets the pending flag this+0x68c and the target-name strings; the main loop then calls the load. LoadLevel skips that deferral. Campaign flow: Main[id0] -> SlotList (PlayerManager::SelectSlot) -> Title -> [id0] here. Post-mission: MenuScreen_LevelResults[id1] -> Title (next mission) -> here; or End.avi + Credits at campaign end.

GameClock::ComputeFrameDelta. dt = elapsed_ms * 0.001, then clamped to [1/60 s, 0.1 s]: `while (dt <= 0.016666668) Sleep(1)` is a hard 60 FPS busy-wait cap; `if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1f` is the 10 FPS floor. Result -> g_frameDeltaTime via GameClock::Tick. One Euler step per frame, no sub-stepping -> the jump apex drifts a few units across this dt range.
FPS CAP + UNCAP: the `while (dt <= 1/60) Sleep(1)` busy-wait. Compares dt vs the double at 0x004dfa20 (= 1/60): entry FCOMP @0x0042bfb4, loop-tail FCOMP @0x0042bff1. Entry guard `JZ 0x0042bfff` @ 0x0042bfbf (bytes 74 3E); loop-back `JNZ 0x0042bfc8` @ 0x0042bffc (75 CA); Sleep at 0x0042bfc8/0x0042bfca. UNCAP: change 0x0042bfbf 74 -> EB (JZ->JMP, wait block entered on no path, PUSH/POP EBX skipped as a pair), OR zero the double at 0x004dfa20 (only 2 xrefs, both here). The SEPARATE dt=0.1f (10 FPS) clamp -- guard 0x0042c00e, store 0x0042c055, const 0x004df7b8 -- is the anti-blowup floor; do NOT patch it.

GameClock::Tick. Pick the active SubTimer by selector byte +0x40, call ComputeFrameDelta on it, publish dt(+0x4c) / elapsedMs(+0x44) / fps / smoothedFps to the outer struct. Pause/resume catch-up: baseMs += timeGetTime() - pauseStamp. Called every frame from GameSession::PumpPendingState. (Cycle 8 mislabeled this "tick the music manager" -- there is no audio here.)

GameClock::SetTimeSource(clock, sel). Write selector byte +0x40, re-base the newly-selected SubTimer via timeGetTime(), set dirty flag. Called with sel=0 from MenuManager::TeardownToLoading.
Also called with sel=1 from MenuManager::Activate (0x0042d480) on menu-open: switches to the free-running "real" SubTimer and PAUSES game-time SubTimer[0]. So g_gameTimeMs-delta cooldowns freeze during a menu (rebased on close) -- but the world sim and the mission timer keep running (see PumpPendingState).
GameClock::Reset. Zero both SubTimers, seed both fps fields to 10.0f, re-base via timeGetTime(), then GameClock::Tick. Clock (re)init.

PlayerHose::Think_AtHotspot (state 4 of the RCS_PlayerHose state machine on this+0x18C; states: 3 Advance / 4 AtHotspot / 5 PrimeStream / 6 GameOver). KEY MECHANIC (medium-high conf): the douse is on a FIXED SCHEDULE, not skill-based. This fn calls Hotspot::AdvanceActiveFire @0x00465a20 UNCONDITIONALLY every frame -- not gated on aim or on holding fire. AdvanceActiveFire round-robins the hotspot's child RCS_WindowFire list; each step -> WindowFire::BeginDouse (its ONLY caller), and WindowFire::Think counts that fire down by g_frameDeltaTime / block+0x08 sec; when the round-robin index wraps, Hotspot+0x20 (douse passes remaining) decrements. So a hotspot always extinguishes after (#fires x passes) steps regardless of player input -- the player's job is purely to SURVIVE the per-hotspot timer (this+0x1A7C, budget this+0x1A84 = HosePathPoint.def+0x28 sec x difficulty mult 1.8/1.3/1.0 for idx 0/1/2). Timer < 0 -> PlayerHose::LoseLevel (this+0x198 = 2). Last hotspot cleared (this+0x1A78 next == 0) -> PlayerHose::WinLevel (this+0x198 = 1). Aiming (STEER_PITCH/YAW) + MOUSE_LB drive ONLY the visible HoseGfx stream, splash particles, spray-loop sound, and the "spraylr" anim -- they do NOT feed douse progress. ScriptActor::Tick (script\scriptactor.cpp). The level "script VM" is a line-oriented STRING interpreter -- no bytecode, no program counter, no goto/labels. Fields: this+0x30/0x34 = command queue (SArrayPtr of strings) + count; this+0x48 = wake-time (ms); this+0x4c = waiting flag (1=waiting); this+0x08 = event-name -> cmdlist map. Per frame: if waiting, clear the flag once global clock DAT_00502afc >= this+0x48; else call vtable slot 0 (subclass think) then ScriptActor::RunQueuedCommand (pops front string of this+0x30 -> ExecCommand). `wait N` (base verb) sets this+0x48 = clock+N and this+0x4c=1 -- the ONLY time model; idle/flush clear it. Conditionals execute their quoted "<cmd>" arg IMMEDIATELY inline via ScriptActor::ExecCommand (recursive), no branch target, no else. ScriptTrigger::AddScriptLine despite its name does NOT queue -- it calls ExecCommand right now. A ScriptTrigger fires when something calls ScriptActor::FireEvent on it (its volume subclass detecting player entry in slot-0 think, or another script's sendmsg).

ParticleSystem::Emit(this, ownerXform, bForce) -- ONE burst of particles. The engine-wide "spawn effect" call (~9+ callers: tools, MiscEmitter impls, fire). Gated by (now <= this+0x34) unless bForce. All particles spawn at a POINT; spread comes only from velocity. Then re-arm +0x34 = ftol(Rand_FloatRange(+0x40,+0x44)) (burst interval). ParticleSystem (0x84) extends ParticlePool (ctor 0x00480260): +0x10 SArray<ParticleEmitter*>, +0x28 RenderManager*, +0x2c prototype ParticleNode*, +0x30 cap (-1 = unbounded). Per-frame: the RenderManager calls vtbl slot 1 (ParticlePool::TickAndRenderParticles @0x0047fea0, was "RenderChildren") which ticks + draws every particle via ParticleNode::Render (AdvanceSpawn ramp walk + IntegrateMotion semi-implicit Euler + geWorld_AddPolyOnce quad). flags&8 on a particle = one-shot (freed on ramp wrap). There is NO decal pool -- "decals" are a single persistent ParticleNode per tool repositioned onto the hit surface each frame.

File_LoadObfuscatedU32Blob -- COPY PROTECTION, not asset loading. Resolves a path relative to the EXE's own directory (GetModuleFileNameA + strip the last backslash, unless the path contains ':' or leads with a double-backslash), opens read-only, requires size >= 4 and size % 4 == 0, reads the whole file into the caller buffer, stores the u32 word count at buf[0], and XOR-decrypts the remainder via XorDecryptBuffer (0x00480590, 400-byte repeating key at DAT_004ff948). Sole caller = the undefined function at ~0x00445520 (CheckGameCD): OutputDebugStringA("Don't blame Mekada"), File_LoadObfuscatedU32Blob(&buf, "texture.dat"), checks two payload bytes ('V' and '.'), returns a 2-bit-masked bool -- a disc/CD-presence check. "texture.dat" is a mis-named protection token file, not a texture.

Damp_RateFromFraction. rate = -ln2 / (refRate * ln(frac)), chosen so pow(0.5, dt/rate) == frac^(refRate*dt). Guards: frac <= ~1e-9 -> 1e-5; frac >= ~1.0 -> clamp. Player movement calls it with refRate = 27.0 and frac = 0.2 (grounded/climb/spectator) or 0.95 (airborne). NOTE: the Ghidra decompiled C for this function is WRONG -- it mis-renders the x87 FYL2X instruction.

Vec3_DampToward (the velocity blend). t = pow(0.5, g_frameDeltaTime / rate); out = target*(1-t) + current*t. With rate from Damp_RateFromFraction this is t = frac^(27*dt): t = fraction of CURRENT retained, (1-t) = fraction of TARGET adopted; a true dt-corrected exponential (frame-rate independent). It is a convex LERP -- there is NO dot(current,targetDir) projection term, so |out| can never exceed max(|current|, |target|). Args (dest, current, target, rate); rate passed on the x87 stack.

Damp -- critically-damped scalar/vector follower that FORCE-SUB-STEPS at a fixed 0.01 s: a dt=0.1 frame runs 10 identical 10 ms CriticalDampStep (0x00483040) calls (its only caller). This is why view-mount / tool-deploy easing (XFormAnimMover::Tick) is frame-rate-independent to ~1e-4. Class (i).

FRAME-RATE: `step = g_frameDeltaTime * speed`; SNAPS to target when `dist^2 < (dt*speed)^2` (class iv). At low FPS the snap radius is larger, so NPC / victim roam paths cut corners near waypoints and arrive up to one frame early. Long-leg travel time is FPS-independent. Does not affect the player.

XFormAnimMover::Tick -- the "+0x15c deploy anim" mover on carried tools (and player locomotion). NOT part of ActorAnimator/AnimSeqPlayer. Samples the bound motion table [this+0x70] (set by XFormAnimMover::Bind @0x00483a20; wired in ItemAnimSeq::Init to wielder[+0x54]+0x34a4) and eases the tool's local xform toward the sampled pose: per-axis lerp of translation [+0x28/+0x2c/+0x30] via easing FUN_00483140; mode bits in [+0x6c] (0x02/0x04/0x08 = threshold with limits [+0x44/48/4c]; 0x10/0x20/0x40 = damped with rates [+0x50..+0x64]); writes rotation-matrix rows [+4..+0x24]; [+0x80]=settled, [+0x81]=snap-on-arrival, [+0x82]=overshoot. Callers: PlayerRescueEnt::UpdateLocomotionAndTools @0x0044faea, ItemAnimSeq @0x0045f610. Used to slide a deployed tool smoothly into place.

MapZoneManager::RebuildZoneOccupants -- per-frame (from PlayerRescueEnt::UpdateZonesAndWin). Pass 1: EntityIter over all MapZone nodes, SArrayPtr::SetCount(zone+0x20, 0) -- clear occupant lists. Pass 2: global entity iter; for each entity with type tag ent[6]==2 (victim) AND state ent[0x48] not in {5,6} (not rescued/safe): get origin via vtbl+0x18 -> +0x28, MapZoneManager::FindZoneContainingPoint (smallest-volume containing zone wins). No containing zone -> GenErr "TMapZoneManager: ERROR Victim \"...\" is not located in any zone!" (MapZone.cpp:57). Else append to zone+0x20, count zone+0x24. A MapZone is a NAMED SET of BoundsTrigger AABBs (built at load by BoundsTrigger::MakeZone -> MapZoneSet::AddTriggerToNamedZone); zone+0x04 = summed box volume (overlap tiebreak). Fire entities are NEVER added to zones.

RadioChatter::Play(String cue, bool immediate) -- THE enqueue-cue-by-name entry point for the game's radio narration (the primary objective/status channel; there is no HUD text). 15 call sites. FindSet(cue) linear scan by TChatterSet name (+0x1c); immediate -> TChatterSet::PlayNext (sequential shuffle), else TChatterSet::PlayRandom (RNG with single-step anti-repeat); set current +0x18, +0x20=1. Cue -> clips: a cue name (e.g. "RC_VictPick") maps to a TChatterSet whose clips are sound-bank entries "RC_VictPick0","RC_VictPick1",... enumerated at load (TChatterSet::Build, "%s%i") until ROCSoundSystem::SoundExists fails. NO priority field, NO interrupt arbitration, NO global cooldown -- a new line just plays over/after the last. Debounce = clip-level anti-repeat + Update() re-checking "still playing" only ~once/1000 ticks (+0x1c gate). Instances: PlayerRescueEnt+0x3540 and PlayerHose+0x208, both inited from the SAME 13-name roster in RadioChatter::Init. BUG: "RC_HoseTimeWarn" (used by HoseDouseFX warn-timer @0x004653b0) is NOT in that roster -> FindSet returns null -> silent no-op. Cue trigger sites: RC_ResLvlStart <- PlayerRescueEnt::Init; RC_PassOut <- PassOut/O2; RC_Pain <- TakeFireDamage @0x00451640; RC_ResTimeWarn <- PlayerRescueEnt::Think (timer low); RC_VictPick/RC_VictDrop <- victim pickup/dropoff; RC_ResLvlWin/RC_ResLvlLose <- RescueHud::Update @0x00458400; RC_OxygenLow <- UpdateO2 (inferred); RC_HoseLvlStart/Win/Lose <- PlayerHose.

MISNAMED: the Ghidra name "ViewRhythm::SampleBobCurve" is WRONG -- this is Path::SamplePos. (1) per-axis linear drag toward 0 using coeff entity+0x114/0x118/0x11c (Think writes {1000,0,1000} grounded / {0,0,0} air / {1000,1000,1000} climb-spectator each frame), clamped so it cannot cross zero. (2) vel(entity+0xfc/0x100/0x104) += accel(entity+0x108/0x10c/0x110)*g_frameDeltaTime (Think sets accel.y=-1000 gravity, 0 for climb/spectator). (3) frame displacement entity+0x90/0x94/0x98 = vel_new*dt + 0.5*accel*dt^2. (4) snapshot prev vel entity+0xf0.. and prev accel entity+0x120... (5) entity+0x12d = entity+0x12c ; entity+0x12c = 0 (one coyote frame). Does NOT touch position or call collision.

ModelEntity::ClipVelocityToPlanes. Sets the grounded flag when contact plane normal.Y >= 0.5 (<=60deg walkable slope). Velocity clip is a PURE projection: d = dot(velocity, n); if (d > 0) velocity -= d*n -- removes only the into-surface component, NO restitution and NO friction coefficient, so tangential speed (including the vertical part on a slope) is 100% preserved. Displacement is recomputed after.

Sample bank parsed from data\resdefs\sound.rrf by ROCResourceParser::ParseSoundBuffer (`SoundBuffer "name" [min max] = "file"`).

Body: if the object's name String @+0x20 is non-empty -> SoundWrap::Stop(this) + SArray_RemovePtr(*(g_gameCtx+8), this); swap +0x20 = arg1 (name/event key); arg2 -> +0x10, arg3 -> +0x14; SArrayPtr::AddOrReuseSlot(*(g_gameCtx+8), this). ~55 callers: sound-cue rebinds (emitters, tools, HUD) AND MenuManager::Init subscribing "MenuMouseDown"/"MenuMouseClick"/"MenuMouseUp" sinks at MenuManager+0x22c/+0x208/+0x250. For the menu sinks the sound path is a harmless no-op. Do not commit to either single name.

operator new -- plain VS2003 malloc wrapper. NO custom pool/arena anywhere in the entity path: every entity is an individual heap block (PlayerRescueEnt 0x3580, VictimRescueEnt 0x22c, ROCWorldEntity 0x30, ...), freed on death (Entity::VectorDeletingDtor 0x0049d550). This is the core obstacle to a raw-memcpy savestate: freed blocks are not re-handed the same address.

g_devMode -- [DEBUG] "ImADeveloper" cvar (g_cvarTable rec @0x004ff530). SOLE WRITER = Config::Load bool store @0x00426c9a/@0x00426cbb ("true"/"false" only); read once, no runtime/console/key/registry/env/argv path. 17 readers. Enables: F2-F11 DBG_* keybinds (BindKey block @0x0043a009 -- but the F4/F7/F8 poll sites are NOT devMode-gated); creation of the dev console object (roc_CreateEngineSubsystems @0x00499361 -- console unreachable without it); GenErr sev-2 console routing; F2/F3 FPS overlay + <15fps HUD sprite; F12 instant-quit; geEngine_EnableAppLog; Left-Ctrl-boot video-mode dialog; skipping the 2 intro AVIs. Does NOT touch assert/fatal handling, spawns, mission timer, physics, RNG seeding, level unlocks, or the title/briefing/slot menu flow.

g_logErrorsToFile -- [DEBUG] "EnableDebugLogging" cvar (g_cvarTable rec @0x004ff550). When set: FUN_00421f90 @0x00421f9e opens "FDNYFirefighter.log"; GenErr::Dispatch @0x004220eb/@0x00422177 appends each error line. LOG-FILE writes only. NOTE: this is NOT the "SkipMenus" byte (that is 0x00502a7a) -- an earlier note had the two swapped.

g_cfg_skipMenus -- [DEBUG] "SkipMenus" cvar (g_cvarTable rec @0x004ff540). Read by GameSession::ReturnToFrontend (0x0042de14) to auto-advance the first 3 frontend screens. A real feature, independent of ImADeveloper. (The decompiler may still print a stale "g_dbg_enableDebugLogging" label for the MOV AL,[0x00502a7a] operand.)

g_cvar_video_DriverName -- cvar "Driver" (g_cvarTable rec 0, section VIDEO, typeId 5 = STRING). String* slot holding the Genesis3D display-driver NAME string (e.g. "(D3D)dgVoodoo DirectX Wrapper"), not an index.
g_cvar_video_ModeName -- cvar "Mode" (g_cvarTable rec 1, section VIDEO, typeId 5 = STRING). String* slot holding the resolution NAME string (e.g. "640x480"), not an index.

g_gameClock -- dual-source frame/game CLOCK (NOT a music manager). Two embedded 0x20-byte SubTimers: +0x00 "game" time (paused by menus/focus loss), +0x20 "real" free-running time. Per SubTimer: prevElapsed, curElapsedMs(+4), baseMs(+8), pauseStamp(+0xc), dtSeconds f32(+0x10), fps(+0x14), smoothedFps(+0x18), pausedFlag u8(+0x1c). FUNCTION.NAME: RichBinaryReader_Stream::Open
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: RichBinaryReader_Stream::Open -- BluelAPI RichBinary block-structured serialization (player saves saves\player%i.rb, editor data). File header = 0x17 bytes: "RICHBINARY"(10) + NUL + version(1) + u32 payload-start + total-file-size. mismatch magic -> "<file> is not a valid RichBinary file." (Reader_Stream.cpp:0x14) mismatch size -> "wrong length. Expected N ... actual M" (Reader_Stream.cpp:0x1b) then Seek(0x17) and read the body. Block header = one LE u32 (split in RichBinaryReader::NextBlock): bits 0..28 (0x1FFFFFFF) = payload size in bytes bits 29..30 (0x60000000) = type: 0 container, 0x20 kind7, 0x40 kind9, 0x60 kind10 bit 31 (0x80000000) = has-name / leaf flag Nesting via a runtime stack (reader[0x46] depth, reader[6+i] = end offset of open block i). Writer reserves the 4-byte header and RichBinaryWriter::EndContainer seeks back to store (finalPos - 4 - hdrPos) -- sizes are always back-patched. Names are numeric tag ids via a global type registry (DAT_004ff40c / count DAT_004ff410): RichBinaryTypeRegistry::FindByTag / FindByName (ci). Array elements use "<name> (%d)". Strings serialize as [u16 len][len bytes], each byte through RichBinary::ScrambleChar. Text variants (Reader_Text / Writer_Text) are std::iostream-based over the same tag stream.

Directives: menumusic:<path> -> LevelManager+0x00; level:<id> -> new TLevelInfo(0x28), append, assign sequential index (+0x18), playable flag +0x14=1, and +0x00 = <id> = THE <id>.bsp world-file base name; rrf:<name> -> +0x08 = "data\resdefs\"+name (per-level ROC resource-def); title:"<text>" -> +0x04 (display title); music:<name> -> +0x0c; time:<minutes> -> +0x10 stored as SECONDS (value*60, default 1200.0); mapcoords:<x>,<y> -> +0x20/+0x24 (campaign-map pin). GameSession::LoadLevel then does String(TLevelInfo+0x00)+".bsp" -> FUN_00471310 and ROCResourceParser::ParseFile(TLevelInfo+0x08). NOTE: there is NO per-level difficulty-scale field (the earlier "idx 0/1 x1.5, idx 2 x1.0" note is unconfirmed/likely wrong -- difficulty is only the per-profile TPlayerInfo+0x2c byte). TLevelInfo+0x1c (-1 default) is unidentified.

FUNCTION.NAME: GameSession::LoadLevel
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
GameSession::LoadLevel(GameSession* this, TLevelInfo* pLI) -- main\evergame.cpp ~245. THE menu-side level start (synchronous). Called from MenuScreen_Title::OnButtonActivate id 0 ("Begin Mission"), after LevelManager::FindByIndex maps the selection index -> TLevelInfo* and MenuManager::TeardownToLoading draws the loading screen. Steps: - trace banner "\n\n!!-- TEverGame: Loading level \"<name>\" --!!" - *(this+0x688) = pLI (set current TLevelInfo*, written twice) - this+0x6f0 = 2 (state=loading); later this+0x6ec = 0 - ROCResourceParser::ParseFile(*(pLI+8)+0xc) -- parse the level ROC resdef (.rrf) - String + ".bsp" -> FUN_00471310(path, 1) -- LOAD THE BSP WORLD - build EntityCreateStruct "World" (type 0x2711), set userdata, flush the entity spawn queue -> World entity - restore category volumes, SoundWrap::ApplyVolume The in-game path GameSession::RequestLevelChange (0x0042a260) is the DEFERRED version: it only sets the pending flag this+0x68c and the target-name strings; the main loop then calls the load. LoadLevel skips that deferral. Campaign flow: Main[id0] -> SlotList (PlayerManager::SelectSlot) -> Title -> [id0] here. Post-mission: MenuScreen_LevelResults[id1] -> Title (next mission) -> here; or End.avi + Credits at campaign end.
The call `(**(code**)(**(g_gameCtx+0x24)+4))()` here IS EntityManager::FlushSpawnQueue (0x0049c670) -- the victim spawn-spot RNG (Rand_FloatRange) happens synchronously inside this blocking load, before the first game frame. A memory-modder freezing the 3 MT19937 globals to reproduce a victim layout must do it just before this call.

FUNCTION.NAME: GameSession::RunFrame
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
GameSession::RunFrame -- per-rendered-frame session update. SAFE POINT for an external savestate: at 0x0042af0f (return of TickSubsystems, before RenderFrame) all spawn queues (session+0x3c0/+0x3c4) and the deferred-callback list (session+0x3bc) are drained, no entity ctor/dtor in flight, renderer not yet mutated this frame. Alt safe point: 0x0042aea0 top (previous frame fully complete). Sim is single-threaded (EXE has zero CreateThread calls); TickSubsystems 0x00429520 then RenderFrame 0x00494670 are 15 bytes apart on the same thread.
[cluster-2 note] frame order is GameClock::Tick -> virtual poll call resolving to GameControls::PollFrame 0x00439330 (drains buffered DirectInput into ActionMap held/edge state) -> TickSubsystems 0x00429520 (entity Think, incl. player) -> RenderFrame. Any hook placed inside/after TickSubsystems (e.g. FDNYFreemanMovement.asi's trampoline) always sees current-frame IsHeld/GetAxis state, never stale.

FUNCTION.NAME: GameClock::ComputeFrameDelta
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
GameClock::ComputeFrameDelta. dt = elapsed_ms * 0.001, then clamped to [1/60 s, 0.1 s]: `while (dt <= 0.016666668) Sleep(1)` is a hard 60 FPS busy-wait cap; `if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1f` is the 10 FPS floor. Result -> g_frameDeltaTime via GameClock::Tick. One Euler step per frame, no sub-stepping -> the jump apex drifts a few units across this dt range.
FPS CAP + UNCAP: the `while (dt <= 1/60) Sleep(1)` busy-wait. Compares dt vs the double at 0x004dfa20 (= 1/60): entry FCOMP @0x0042bfb4, loop-tail FCOMP @0x0042bff1. Entry guard `JZ 0x0042bfff` @ 0x0042bfbf (bytes 74 3E); loop-back `JNZ 0x0042bfc8` @ 0x0042bffc (75 CA); Sleep at 0x0042bfc8/0x0042bfca. UNCAP: change 0x0042bfbf 74 -> EB (JZ->JMP, wait block entered on no path, PUSH/POP EBX skipped as a pair), OR zero the double at 0x004dfa20 (only 2 xrefs, both here). The SEPARATE dt=0.1f (10 FPS) clamp -- guard 0x0042c00e, store 0x0042c055, const 0x004df7b8 -- is the anti-blowup floor; do NOT patch it.

FUNCTION.NAME: GameClock::Tick
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: GameClock::Tick. Pick the active SubTimer by selector byte +0x40, call ComputeFrameDelta on it, publish dt(+0x4c) / elapsedMs(+0x44) / fps / smoothedFps to the outer struct. Pause/resume catch-up: baseMs += timeGetTime() - pauseStamp. Called every frame from GameSession::PumpPendingState. (Cycle 8 mislabeled this "tick the music manager" -- there is no audio here.)

FUNCTION.NAME: GameClock::SetTimeSource

GameClock::SetTimeSource(clock, sel). Write selector byte +0x40, re-base the newly-selected SubTimer via timeGetTime(), set dirty flag. Called with sel=0 from MenuManager::TeardownToLoading.
Also called with sel=1 from MenuManager::Activate (0x0042d480) on menu-open: switches to the free-running "real" SubTimer and PAUSES game-time SubTimer[0]. Per frame: current_z += dt*speed, clamp toward open_z/closed_z; when |current_z - closed_z| < eps -> TE_BModel::UpdateMapZones @0x0043c1a0. FUNCTION.NAME: BModelEnt::DepenetrateFromWorld
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
BModelEnt::DepenetrateFromWorld (undefined region). The player's only per-frame world collision. Swept collide-and-slide: TraceToFloor (0x00492ce0) = geWorld_Collision(world, boxMin(+0x78), boxMax(+0x84), start(+0x68), start+disp(+0x90), 0x43, 2, ...) -- a genuine swept box over the whole move, so an in-mask solid on the segment is hit at ANY dt (no tunnelling). On hit: <=5 plane-clip iterations (CMP EBX,5 / JGE 0x0043f7f0); the push-out virtual [vtbl+0x38] is a RET-4 stub, so ejection never happens -- overflow falls through to ClipVelocitySimple (0x0049e040), which ZEROES disp+velocity on a wall (normal.Y<0.5) or flags grounded on a floor. FAILS SAFE: pos += disp then adds nothing. Normal play uses 1-2 iterations.
--- cluster-1 update: __thiscall(entity). The player's only per-frame world collision. Single caller: PlayerRescueEnt::Think 0x004537db (skipped when entity+0x380 spectator set). GetCollisionBlock [vtbl+0xc] recomputes world AABB entity+0x68.. from transform entity+0x24; then up to 5x: ROCRender::TraceToFloor 0x00492ce0 (swept box: AABB min entity+0x78, max entity+0x84, start entity+0x68, end from delta entity+0x90, contents mask 0x43, collideflags 2) -> [vtbl+0x38] push-out (stub 0x0049db80, RET 4 - no-op) -> re-trace; on overflow CALL ClipVelocitySimple 0x0049e040. Writes clipped delta entity+0x90.., zeroes vel component on wall, sets entity+0x12c on floor.
UPDATE 2026-10-16: for the player, vtable+0x38 = BModelEnt::Think 0x0043f810 (NOT a stub). Loop: sweep origin+0x68 along disp+0x90 (traced even if disp==0); miss -> return; hit -> MoveReq (+0 impact, +0xc normal) -> Think (return ignored) -> re-sweep; ClipVelocitySimple 0x0049e040 only after 5 consecutive hits. FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: player-stuck cycle: pos(entity+0x4c/50/54) = spawn anchor(entity+0x534/538/53c); yaw(+0x3434)=anchor heading(+0x530); mirrors the just-set pos into the cache entity+0x3400/3404/3408; zeroes velocity/accel/tool state; calls ModelEntity::SnapToFloor 0x0049da00 (the buggy one -- if the anchor position has no floor beneath it, e.g. a bad Verb_Escape checkpoint, the player lands at world origin (0,1,0) instead).

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::Init
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: PlayerRescueEnt::Init -- primary vtbl slot 8 (0x4e1c68). Large one-time init (~0x0044d550-0x0044e7d3). Constructs sub-objects, sets crouch/stand AABB (this+0x74=45.0, this+0x78/0x84 extents), zeroes state fields (this+0x3428/0x3430/0x3434/0x3440), inits RescueBot (this+0x34a4) and RescueHud (this+0x5f4). ANIM-EVENT BINDING (this is the "BindAnimEvents" section, ~0x0044d7b2 onward): for each name in the table @0x004e18ec (Jump, LandingImpact, Breathe, OxyRelease, PassOut_O2, PassOut_Fire, GrabItem, ValveHookUp, ThrowObject, ActionFailed, FootStep1-4) it builds a per-event binding object at this+0x3a0 + i*0x24 (Jump=0x3a0, Breathe=0x3c4, LandingImpact=0x3e8, OxyRelease=0x40c ...) via FUN_004a12f0(&slot, &String(name), callbackId, flag).

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::Verb_Jump
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
gated on onground byte [entity+0x12c]; grounded jump does vy (entity+0x100) += 400.0 additive; 500ms cooldown stamp at entity+0x388.
--- cluster-5 decompile: writes ONLY entity+0x100 (velocity.y): += 400.0 on a normal grounded jump (gated on entity+0x12c onground != 0, else no-op and no cooldown stamp), or = 400.0 on a ladder-exit jump (state entity+0x18c 5 -> 3). Plus a 500ms cooldown stamp at entity+0x388. It does NOT write the entity+0x5b8 impulse accumulator (cluster-1's inference corrected). dt-independent, single-axis; no dependency on entity+0x90 frame delta.

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::UpdateLocomotionAndTools
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
TOOL VECTORS: the active tool's +0x1e4 / +0x1f0 are read here into player+0x3488 = the ViewRhythm view-sway offset (weapon/camera sway) -- NOT body velocity. (The separate "reaction velocity" that CAN touch player+0xfc is the tool vtable slot +0x34, read in Think, and it is a zero vec for Axe/Extinguisher, ~1 u/s for the Hose.)
--- cluster-1 update: __thiscall(entity, movedFlag, 1, 1.0f). Called from Think 0x00453860 AFTER the move. NOT body physics: ViewRhythm view-sway -> entity+0x3488; per-tool tick + ACTION handlers; EntityCam update (entity+0x34a0, EntityCam::PitchBy(entity+0x3430)); XFormAnimMover::Tick(entity+0x34e4) = animation. Reads entity+0x90 frame delta + entity+0x12c onground.
cluster-3/4: the per-frame camera EYE position is NOT origin+constant -- it's a per-ACTIVE-TOOL bone/attach-point transform (tool+0x1e4/0x1f0), cross-blended by a lerp (Vec3_ScaleBy/Vec3_Scale), ultimately still rooted in entity+0x24 (whose translation IS entity+0x4c/50/54, per GetCollisionBlock above). Runs AFTER the locomotion position-commit (Think 0x004537e0..0x00453815), so it re-derives the eye from whatever position was just written -- a v0.2 detour does NOT need to register FreemanAPI's SetGamePlayerViewPosition/ViewAngle callbacks; writing entity+0x4c/50/54 is sufficient for the camera to follow, same as vanilla. One gap: did not verify at runtime whether EntityCam vtbl+0x14 (position setter) reads live vs a cached copy of entity+0x24 -- recommend confirming empirically during v0.2 playtesting rather than further static tracing.

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::EndMission
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: PlayerRescueEnt::EndMission -- lazily counts the total rescuable victims when +0x3528 holds the -1 sentinel: walks the entity list counting +0x18==2 (RCS_VictimRescue) into +0x3528. Called from Verb_FinalExit / Verb_FinalExitLoadMap before the outstanding-victims gate. Victim accounting fields (PlayerRescueEnt primary base): +0x3528 total rescuable, +0x352c delivered/rescued (bumped in DeliverCarriedSurvivor @0x00451160), +0x3530 lost/dead (subtracted in the outstanding formula; medium confidence, not directly observed being written), +0x3438 mission result 0/1/2, +0x3428 reset counter, +0x32e4 rescuebot-enabled bool, +0x3540 the RadioChatter object.

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::Verb_Reset
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
PlayerRescueEnt::Verb_Reset -- the only lightweight in-engine respawn. Restores PLAYER POSITION ONLY from the Vec3 respawn anchor at this+0x3400/04/08 (set at Init, updatable by scripted-sequence triggers), plus: drop carried victim (+0x3534), ResetLocomotionState, RescueHud::Reset, reset counter +0x3428++. Does NOT restore O2 (+0x3450), mission timer (+0x343c), entities, fire, or victims. Not a state-capture primitive.
player-stuck cycle: full decompile obtained. Teleports player to the spawn/checkpoint anchor entity+0x534/0x538/0x53c via ResetLocomotionState 0x0044cd10 (position=anchor, velocity/tool-state zeroed, calls the buggy SnapToFloor). Drops any carried victim (DropAtPlayer, +-30u Y nudge). In mission-state 2 with a non-quiet reset: tallies 'herodown' entities, may spawn an RCS_VictimRescue placeholder, logs GenErr 'Firefighters down = N'. Does NOT touch O2(+0x3450) or mission timer(+0x343c). ONLY 3 callers in the whole binary: (1) dev/script 'reset' command via OnScriptCommand 0x0045243e, (2) PassOut's param==2 branch 0x00451038, (3) UpdatePassedOut's timer-expired branch 0x004510e6 (O2/health death). NEVER triggered by falling out of bounds or any detected stuck condition -- this is a manual/scripted hard-reset, not automatic stuck-recovery.
NOTE (revises prior line above re: "+0x3400/04/08" being THE anchor): entity+0x3400/04/08 is actually only a position-MIRROR cache written by ResetLocomotionState, not independently maintained -- the real, updatable spawn/checkpoint anchor lives at entity+0x534/538/53c and is written by Verb_Escape 0x004513a0 at runtime (see that function's comment and symbol entity+0x534).

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::BeginCarrySurvivor
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: PlayerRescueEnt::BeginCarrySurvivor -- handler body for message 0x7532 (sent by VictimRescueEnt::TestPlayerPickupProximity @0x0045a070 when the player AABB overlaps the victim's pickup radius = victim-def +0x1c clamped to >= 60u -- NO key press, NO facing check, automatic on contact). Guard player+0x3534 == 0 (not already carrying); player+0x3534 = victim; VictimRescueEnt::OnClaimedByPlayer (victim+0x120=5, stop anim, fire "pickup"); PlayerRescueEnt::BroadcastCarryState(1) (notify camera-rig kind-3 + final-exit kind-8 entities -> HUD arrows / exit enable); ViewRhythm::AddLandingImpact; RescueHud::OnEvent(1); MapZoneManager::RebuildZoneOccupants; player+0x5c4 = now (carry-start timestamp for the Rescue Time stat). THE CARRY IS ABSTRACT: there is NO per-frame reparenting of the victim to a player bone/offset. The state-5 victim is frozen where it was picked up, invisible to zone/claim logic, until delivery. NO carry penalty exists -- UpdateO2 drains a flat 0.05/3000ms regardless, and the Think speed caps are state-based only (400/260/800). Deliver = `escape` verb -> Verb_Escape -> DeliverCarriedSurvivor @0x00451160: +0x352c (delivered) += 1, PlayerStats "Rescues" +1 + submit rescue time, VictimRescueEnt::WarpToRescuerAndFade @0x0045c000 (victim+0x120=6, teleport ~120u ahead of rescuer, SnapToFloor, fire "rescue", arm blink-out), clear +0x3534, BroadcastCarryState(0), UpdateZonesAndWin. Drop on death while carrying = Verb_Reset -> VictimRescueEnt::DropAtPlayer @0x0045c1a0 (victim+0x120=4, reposition at player, fire "passout", NO credit).

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::UpdateZonesAndWin
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
PlayerRescueEnt::UpdateZonesAndWin -- per-frame. First: MapZoneManager::RebuildZoneOccupants(this+0x5d8) (clears every MapZone occupant list and repopulates it with live victims -- ent[6]==2, state ent[0x48] not in {5,6}).
CORRECTION (cycle 13, supersedes the earlier "every exit zone clear of fire" reading -- that was WRONG; MapZones only track VICTIMS, never fire): the auto-win check runs only once rescued-count reaches the requirement (guard on +0x3528/+0x352c/+0x3530; +0x3528==-1 -> EndMission first). It then walks all entities with type tag [0x18]==8 (final-exit BoundsTrigger volumes) whose `touch` event is bound to "tell player finalexit" / "tell player (finalexitloadmap"; for each it resolves the containing MapZone and adds it (deduped) to a local list. local_b0 = number of distinct zones hosting an active final-exit trigger. - local_b0 == 0 -> no exit gate exists -> set +0x3438 = 1 (win) + PlayerRescueEnt::OnLevelWon. - local_b0 > 0 -> write HUD "All of the survivors have been rescued! Exit through:\n<zone names>" and enable each exit box (FUN_00440f50(box,1)). So rescuing all victims does NOT itself win -- the player must then reach a final-exit volume (or a script calls `finalexit`). Any fire-gating of the exits is implemented where the exit boxes are enabled/disabled, not here.
GATE: `delivered(+0x352c) >= total(+0x3528) - lost(+0x3530)` -- `>=`, unlike Verb_FinalExit's strict `==`. Victim-gated and fire-INDEPENDENT (MapZones track victims, never fire). Zero final-exit volumes -> instant win (+0x3438=1 + OnLevelWon); else opens the exit boxes + HUD text, no win until an exit is touched.

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::Verb_FinalExit
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: PlayerRescueEnt::Verb_FinalExit. `if (+0x3528 == -1) EndMission()` (lazy tally); then gate `((+0x3528 total) - (+0x3530 lost) - (+0x352c delivered)) == 0` -- STRICT equality, no <=. On pass: +0x3438 = 1 + OnLevelWon, from ANY position (no positional check at all). +0x3530 is dead (victims cannot die) so outstanding = total - delivered. Over-delivery -> negative -> gate fails permanently (softlock, not a skip).

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::Verb_FinalExitLoadMap
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: PlayerRescueEnt::Verb_FinalExitLoadMap -- script verb `tell player finalexitloadmap <mapname>`. THE map-to-map campaign transition. Same victim gate as Verb_FinalExit (outstanding = +0x3528 - +0x3530 - +0x352c must be 0). When clear: verify the map file exists (FUN_004097f0), then GameSession::RequestLevelChange(DAT_00502aac, <mapname arg>, "data\\resdefs\\rescue.rrf") -- the in-game DEFERRED level-change path (sets session+0x68c; the main loop performs the load via GameSession::LoadLevel). Missing file -> GenErr "File not found: " at PlayerRescueEnt.cpp:0x589. If outstanding>0 -> HUD "N survivors remain", no transition. This is the ONLY map transition on the player actor.

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::DeliverCarriedSurvivor
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
MISNAMED: Ghidra name "TeleportToCheckpoint" is WRONG. This is PlayerRescueEnt::DeliverCarriedSurvivor -- the helper for the `escape` verb (Verb_Escape @0x004513a0 tail-calls it). It does NOT teleport. If carrying a victim (+0x3534 != 0): rescued counter +0x352c += 1, PlayerStats::AddStat("Rescues",1), submit "Longest/Shortest Rescue Time", FUN_0045c000(victim,player) releases the victim to safety, RescueHud::OnEvent(2), RescueBot::ArmRescueAttemptTimer, clears +0x3534, then PlayerRescueEnt::UpdateZonesAndWin. The real teleport-on-passout logic is in UpdatePassedOut/PassOut/UpdateCheckpoint. rename_symbol cannot re-target a Namespace::Name -- correction lives here + in research.db.
DELIVERY SKIP: the ONLY gate is +0x3534 != 0 ("carrying a victim"). Then +0x352c(delivered) += 1, PlayerStats "Rescues" += 1, WarpToRescuerAndFade, clear carry, UpdateZonesAndWin. No zone / ground / distance / exit check. Called unconditionally by Verb_Escape.

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::Verb_Escape
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
PlayerRescueEnt::Verb_Escape. The `if (onGround(+0x12c) && +0x3450 > 0.5)` block gates ONLY the checkpoint pos/yaw snapshot (+0x3434 there is the saved yaw, not a gate). It then UNCONDITIONALLY tail-calls DeliverCarriedSurvivor (0x00451160) -- so `escape` delivers + credits a carried victim from ANY position with no zone/ground/distance check. Speedrun: escape x N + finalexit skips the "rescue all + walk to exit" requirement.
player-stuck cycle: this is the game's ONLY checkpoint-setting mechanism. If onground(entity+0x12c) && entity+0x3450(O2/health stat) > 0.5: OVERWRITES the spawn anchor entity+0x534/0x538/0x53c with the player's CURRENT position+heading (entity+0x4c/0x50/0x54/0x3434), before unconditionally tail-calling DeliverCarriedSurvivor. Reached via BoundsTriggerEnt's default 'touch' event -> script command 'tell player escape' -> OnScriptCommand 0x00451c19. Means Verb_Reset's destination is NOT fixed for the level -- it moves to wherever the player last successfully escaped-with-a-survivor. (The existing speedrun-exploit comment above about escape x N + finalexit -- this checkpoint-mutation behavior is the mechanism behind it.)

FUNCTION.NAME: RescueBot::Construct
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: enabled(+0x18) defaults to 1 here (MOV byte [ESI+0x18],1 @ 0x004514F0) -- the bot is ON on every level unless a script runs `setrescuebot 0` (only training.bsp does). Corrected 2026-10-13: earlier notes called the bot opt-in.

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::UpdateO2
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: PlayerRescueEnt::UpdateO2 -- SCBA air-fraction drain/refill (called at the tail of PlayerRescueEnt::Think). this+0x3450 = O2 fraction [0..1] (reset to 1.0 by ResetLocomotionState). this+0x3458 = boost-active-until ms (0x7fffffff = off). NOT boosted (this+0x3458 < now): every 3000 ms -> play gasp cue SoundCue this+0x3c4; O2 -= 0.05; this+0x3454 = now + 3000. O2 <= 0 -> O2 = 0; PlayerRescueEnt::PassOut(mode 0). O2 < 0.8 -> set low-air flag this+0x52c. => full 1.0 -> 0 in 20 x 3s ~= 60 seconds. Difficulty-independent. Smoke/ash does NOT affect this. BOOSTED (this+0x3458 >= now, i.e. within 700ms of Verb_OxygenOn / at an oxygen station): O2 += dt * 0.1 (~10s refill), clamp 1.0, play SoundCue this+0x40c and clear this+0x52c on reaching full. Mission clock (separate): this+0x343c seconds, set in Init = (TLevelInfo+0x10 or 600) x difficulty (idx0/1->1.5, idx2->1.0); Think does this+0x343c -= dt; < 0 -> this+0x343c=0, this+0x3438=2 (the ONLY true level loss -> RC_ResLvlLose). RC_ResTimeWarn fires on the downward crossing of 30s. Difficulty index = *(*(g_session+0x6e4)+0x2c) where g_session+0x6e4 = the active TPlayerInfo* (NOT a mission controller).

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::TakeFireDamage
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: PlayerRescueEnt::TakeFireDamage. Writes ONLY: 4 directional flinch bool flags player+0x353c..0x353f (via SetFireFlinchDir 0x0044bb00), player+0x390 = Ftol(Rand 1000..2500) (RC_Pain chatter cooldown), player+0x3538 += g_frameDeltaTime*1.2*intensity (>1.0 -> PassOut(1)), PlayerStats "Serious Burns". NO write to velocity / external-accel / camera. Zero kinetic impulse -- there is no fire damage-boost.

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::Think
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
View angles: pitch = entity+0x3430, yaw = entity+0x3434 (degrees, Genesis Y-up LH, no roll), accumulated from GameControls::GetAxis("STEER_PITCH"/"STEER_YAW"); pitch clamped +/-{20,40,70} by difficulty. EntityCam sub-object at entity+0x3460. Movement input via GameControls named-action API: IsHeld("MOVE_FORWARD"/"MOVE_BACKWARD"/"MOVE_LEFT"/"MOVE_RIGHT"/"JUMP"), WasPressed("CROUCH"/"USE") -- NO stored wishdir, transient local (strafe+/-0.75, 0, fwd+/-1.0) rotated by yaw-only basis, blended into +0xfc via Vec3_DampToward (frac 0.2 ground / 0.95 air). move-freeze flag entity+0x345c. jump cooldown stamp entity+0x388. locomotion state machine entity+0x18c (3 stand / 4 crouch / 5 climb-spectator / 6 passed-out / 7 ...).
--- cluster-1 update: Per-frame player update, __thiscall(ECX=entity+0x140). Movement is HAND-INLINED here, no move fn. Wishdir/damp block 0x00452cfb-0x0045364d writes velocity+0xfc & gravity+0x10c. Locomotion region (integrate+world-resolve+commit) = 0x00453789..0x00453815, also the state==7 (entity+0x18c) jump target: [1] vel += impulse(entity+0x5b8)*dt inline; [2] CALL [primary_vtbl+0x64]=0x0043f680 -> Entity::IntegrateVelocity; [3] if !spectator(entity+0x380) CALL 0x0043f6d0 DepenetrateFromWorld; [4] pos(entity+0x4c..0x54) += delta(entity+0x90..0x98) inline. After 0x00453815: UpdateLocomotionAndTools(0x0044f340 = camera+animation), StepScriptedSequence, RescueBot, carried-object, Vec3_Set(entity+0x5b8,0), UpdateO2 -- none author body pos/vel except held-object pose; animation reads entity+0x90 delta. FDNY has NO Quake accel/airaccel: horizontal = exp Vec3_DampToward toward wishdir*maxspeed (400 stand/260 crouch/800 spectator), retain frac 0.2 vs 0.95 by ground/air.
--- cluster-5 splice-safety result: replacing ONLY 0x00453789..0x00453815 for states 3/4 (toggle-gated), replaying the vanilla 4 steps for states 5/6/7 + spectator, is SAFE w.r.t. UpdatePassedOut, UpdateO2, StepScriptedSequence, RescueBot::Think, the carried-object block, StandUp/Duck, and Verb_Jump -- none read or write player pos/vel/onground in a way that depends on locomotion-span internals beyond the final committed entity+0x4c..0x54 / entity+0xfc..0x104 / entity+0x12c. NOTE: the wishdir/Vec3_DampToward block (~0x004532b3-0x004532ef, upstream of the span) has ALREADY FDNY-damped entity+0xfc/0x104 toward wishdir*maxspeed by the time the span runs -- a v0.2 HL detour must keep glue-authoritative velocity and restore entity+0xfc from it, treating the pre-span damp as a clobbered write. States 5 & 7 execute this same span (only state 6 fully bypasses via the UpdatePassedOut branch), so the detour's state-gate must be airtight. Extra vanilla early-return: crouched + JUMP (pressed->StandUp+return, or not-pressed->return) skips the span AND UpdateO2 that frame.

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerRescueEnt::Construct
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: PlayerRescueEnt::Construct -- ROC class "RCS_PlayerRescue" (rescue\PlayerRescueEnt.cpp). THE central object. *(g_gameCtx+0x30) points at the single instance. It is BOTH: - the player character (owns pos +0xFC, velocity +0x110, grounded +0x240; movement + world collision run in its Think; jump/crouch/climb/oxy verbs in OnScriptCommand), AND - the level/mission controller (mission state +0x18C, timer +0x32FC, victim counts +0x33E8/+0x33EC/+0x33F0, carry cap +0x3530, outcome +0x3528, zone mgr +0x5D8, subtitle sink +0x5F4). Inheritance: WorldEntity <- ModelEntity <- BModelEnt <- PlayerRescueEnt (primary vtbl 0x004e1c48, 27 slots); secondary base vtbl 0x004dfc30 at +0x24 (GameControls/input-sink mixin, not overridden); embedded ScriptActor at +0x140 (vtbl 0x004e1c40: [0]=Think @0x00452570, [1]=OnScriptCommand @0x00451870). Embedded RescueBot at +0x340C. Method cluster ~0x0044bc00-0x004545c0. Note: earlier "GameLevel*" names refer to this class.

FUNCTION.NAME: RescueBot::ArmRescueAttemptTimer
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: RescueBot::ArmRescueAttemptTimer. attemptTimer(+0x14) = base + Rand_Below(30000) OR floor + Rand_Below(60000) -- the interval between the bot's rescue attempts is RNG (global MT19937). Split-relevant: RescueBot::Think's dropoff branch calls PlayerRescueEnt::UpdateZonesAndWin, so a bot rescue removes a required victim and can flip the win/finalexit gate. BUT the bot is opt-in (runrescuebot verb / dev-only DBG_ACTIVATE_RESCUEBOT) -- default missions never enable it.

FUNCTION.NAME: RescueBot::BeginRescue
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: RescueBot::BeginRescue(this, victimEnt, victimName) RescueBot is a sub-object embedded at GameLevel+0x340C, where GameLevel = *(g_gameCtx+0x30) (the 0x3580-byte scene/level object: vftable 0x4e1c48, holds the child-entity list at +0x176, the RescueHud at +0x2160, mission state at +0x18c, victim-carry cap at +0x3530, subtitle sink at +0x5f4). Flow: - Rescue_PickRandomRosterName() -> speaker/victim tag; post "^(128,128,240)<name>, from ... :" console line - Entity_GetZoneName(victimEnt) -> "... in <zone>" - (*(victimEnt+0x60))() mark victim as being-rescued - this->currentVictim (+0x04) = victimEnt - ++*(GameLevel+0x3530) (active-rescue / carried count) - this->dropoffTimer (+0x00) = now + 4000 + Rand_Below(4000) Corrects earlier note: the counter/sink are on GameLevel (*(g_gameCtx+0x30)), not on g_gameCtx+0x30 itself.

FUNCTION.NAME: RescueBot::TryStartRescue
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
RescueBot::TryStartRescue(RescueBot* this) -- scan for an eligible victim and begin. CORRECTION: the "[0x48]" check reads victim+0x120 (VictimRescueEnt FSM state), NOT Entity+0x18 (entity kind). Entity kinds (Entity+0x18): 1=PlayerRescueEnt, 2=VictimRescueEnt, 6=collision obstacle/bounds volume, 8=final-exit trigger. Victim state (VictimRescueEnt+0x120): 4=idle/waiting, 5=claimed by player, 6=claimed by bot, 7=validated+reachable. - if this->currentVictim(+0x04) != 0: "RESCUEBOT: Already rescuing someone"; return - iterate PlayerRescueEnt child-entity list (field +0x176) via EntityIter - keep candidate iff victim.state (+0x120) in {4,7} AND victim.claimed byte (+0x1fd) == 0 - LOS check FUN_00490130; distance = |bot.pos - victim.pos| >= 600.0 - first match -> RescueBot::BeginRescue(this, ent, name), which calls VictimRescueEnt::OnBotRescueBegin (sets victim.state = 6, fires "botrescue" script event); else "RESCUEBOT: No eligible victims" Also invoked from the console command handler around 0x0047502e.
Sole caller of RescueBot::BeginRescue (0x00455458). Callers: RescueBot::Think 0x00455732 (timer/cap path) and ScriptTrigger::Verb_RunRescueBot 0x0047502E (bypasses both the enabled byte and the cap); both ignore the return value. thiscall, no stack args, plain RETs at 0x004552F0 (busy early-out) and 0x00455572. FDNYDeterministic.asi patches its first byte to C3 to disable all bot rescues.

FUNCTION.NAME: RescueBot::Think
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: RescueBot::Think -- THE RESCUE BOT HAS NO PATHFINDING AND NO PHYSICAL MOVEMENT. It is a pure timer abstraction at GameLevel+0x340C. No nav mesh, no waypoint graph, no PathPoint follow, no bot entity position update, no unstick. Per frame (no-op unless +0x18 enabled and GameLevel+0x18c != 6): - if currentVictim(+0x04) != 0 and dropoffTimer(+0x00) < now -> UpdateZonesAndWin, log "RESCUEBOT: Victim dropped off", currentVictim = 0. (That 4-8s wall-clock wait IS the entire "carry the victim out".) - if currentVictim == 0 and mission state in {3,4,5} and attemptTimer(+0x14) < now -> if GameLevel+0x3530 (in-progress) >= cap: log "Exceeded maximum of N victims"; else RescueBot::TryStartRescue; then ArmRescueAttemptTimer. - chatter: chatterTimer(+0x10) < now -> push a random urge line to the subtitle sink, re-arm. TryStartRescue @0x00455230: iterate the PlayerRescueEnt child-entity list; take the FIRST victim with +0x120 in {4,7} AND +0x1fd == 0 (norescuebot NOT set) AND clear LOS AND distance >= 600.0 (near victims left for the player). Not nearest / not lowest-O2. -> BeginRescue. FUNCTION.NAME: VictimRescueEnt::SpawnAtSpot
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
VictimRescueEnt::SpawnAtSpot (vtable +0x24). Runs UNCONDITIONALLY on every victim during pass 2 of EntityManager::FlushSpawnQueue. Picks one spawn spot uniformly at random: idx = Ftol(Rand_FloatRange(0.0, count-0.01)); copies spotArray[idx] {vec3, angle@+0xc} (0x10-byte record from the SArray at entity+0x200, count +0x204) into entity+0x4c (pos) / +0x16c (facing); ModelEntity::SnapToFloor; then random-rolls a skin/material variant. Single draw at spawn -- never re-rolled. count==1 -> idx forced to 0 (spawn exactly on the editor origin).
ANTI-RACE: writes PlayerRescueEnt+0x3528 = -1 on every victim spawn, forcing a fresh EndMission tally next frame. This is why a script `finalexit` fired before victims are counted cannot get an empty-tally instant win -- FlushSpawnQueue completes synchronously during load.
SPAWN-SPOT LIST is an SArrayPtr of POINTERS: victim+0x200 -> P (array of 4-byte ptrs), victim+0x204 = count; record = P[idx] = a separate operator-new(0x10) block {float x@0,y@4,z@8,angle@0xc}. So record = (*(void***)(victim+0x200))[idx] -- two dereferences. ONE MT draw here (Rand_FloatRange -> Rand_Float01). count==1 -> idx 0 (editor origin). Skin/material = deterministic per-type round-robin (DAT_00502cc0), NOT RNG. To reproduce a victim layout: snapshot/restore g_mtState (0x00501a28, 624 dw) + g_mtWordsRemaining (0x004ff370) + g_mtNextPtr (0x005023ec) at EntityManager::FlushSpawnQueue entry.

FUNCTION.NAME: Hotspot::AdvanceActiveFire
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: FRAME-RATE: FPS-INDEPENDENT (earlier hypothesis of a per-frame cursor was wrong). The `+0x4 += 1` round-robin step early-returns while the current child's latch (child->[+0x2a8]+0xd) is set; WindowFire::BeginDouse (0x00468850) sets it, WindowFire::Think (0x00468680) clears it only after `+0x258 -= g_frameDeltaTime / blockSec` expires. Douse schedule = sum(blockSec) real seconds at any FPS. Only quirk: <=1 cursor step per frame, so blockSec < frametime makes the douse SLOWER at very low FPS, never faster.

FUNCTION.NAME: PlayerHose::Think_AtHotspot
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: PlayerHose::Think_AtHotspot (state 4 of the RCS_PlayerHose state machine on this+0x18C; states: 3 Advance / 4 AtHotspot / 5 PrimeStream / 6 GameOver). KEY MECHANIC (medium-high conf): the douse is on a FIXED SCHEDULE, not skill-based. This fn calls Hotspot::AdvanceActiveFire @0x00465a20 UNCONDITIONALLY every frame -- not gated on aim or on holding fire. AdvanceActiveFire round-robins the hotspot's child RCS_WindowFire list; each step -> WindowFire::BeginDouse (its ONLY caller), and WindowFire::Think counts that fire down by g_frameDeltaTime / block+0x08 sec; when the round-robin index wraps, Hotspot+0x20 (douse passes remaining) decrements. Hotspot::IsCleared <=> Hotspot+0x20 <= 1. So a hotspot always extinguishes after (#fires x passes) steps regardless of player input -- the player's job is purely to SURVIVE the per-hotspot timer (this+0x1A7C, budget this+0x1A84 = HosePathPoint.def+0x28 sec x difficulty mult 1.8/1.3/1.0 for idx 0/1/2). Timer < 0 -> PlayerHose::LoseLevel (this+0x198 = 2). Last hotspot cleared (this+0x1A78 next == 0) -> PlayerHose::WinLevel (this+0x198 = 1). Aiming (STEER_PITCH/YAW) + MOUSE_LB drive ONLY the visible HoseGfx stream, splash particles, spray-loop sound, and the "spraylr" anim -- they do NOT feed douse progress. HoseGfx::RebuildGeometry does trace the stream vs world (impact pt HoseGfx+0x0C) but only for splash VFX. The hose level result lives on the entity at +0x198 (NOT session+0x6ec, which is the PlayerRescueEnt path); RCS_DouseHose polls owner+0x198 for the win/lose banner + audio.

Dispatch cascade: a. ScriptActor::HandleBaseVerb -- stricmp if-chain for base verbs: que, flush, wait, idle, cmd, loopinque, onmsg, onmsgappend, printmsgs b. if unhandled: virtual call (*(*this+4))() == vtable slot 1 -> subclass verb handler (for triggers: ScriptTrigger::HandleVerb, ~45 verbs) c. still unhandled: "Unknown script command: \"<verb>\"" Cross-actor: `tell <actor> <cmd...>` / `action` -> ScriptEngine::FindActor(name) (linear name scan of g_scriptEngine actor array +0x7c/+0x80) then re-enter ExecCommand on that actor. Events: TScriptActor has a name->commandlist map at this+0x08; ScriptActor::BindEventCommand inserts, ScriptActor::FireEvent(name) runs every bound command via ExecCommand. g_scriptHelpRegistry (0x00503078) is help text ONLY (Syntax/Context/Notes for `help`/`listvars`), not used for dispatch.

FUNCTION.NAME: ScriptActor::Tick
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ScriptActor::Tick (script\scriptactor.cpp). The level "script VM" is a line-oriented STRING interpreter -- no bytecode, no program counter, no goto/labels. Fields: this+0x30/0x34 = command queue (SArrayPtr of strings) + count; this+0x48 = wake-time (ms); this+0x4c = waiting flag (1=waiting); this+0x08 = event-name -> cmdlist map. Per frame: if waiting, clear the flag once global clock DAT_00502afc >= this+0x48; else call vtable slot 0 (subclass think) then ScriptActor::RunQueuedCommand (pops front string of this+0x30 -> ExecCommand). `wait N` (base verb) sets this+0x48 = clock+N and this+0x4c=1 -- the ONLY time model; idle/flush clear it. Conditionals execute their quoted "<cmd>" arg IMMEDIATELY inline via ScriptActor::ExecCommand (recursive), no branch target, no else. ScriptTrigger::AddScriptLine despite its name does NOT queue -- it calls ExecCommand right now. A ScriptTrigger fires when something calls ScriptActor::FireEvent on it (its volume subclass detecting player entry in slot-0 think, or another script's sendmsg).

FUNCTION.NAME: BoundsTrigger::DispatchTouchEvents
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: BoundsTrigger::DispatchTouchEvents(this) -- per-frame, driven from the GameLevel zone system. Pulls 3 entity lists from the zone (FUN_00490300 just-entered, FUN_00490380 still-inside, FUN_004903a0 just-left). For each entity: set current-toucher context = ScriptEngine::BindToucherEntity(g_scriptEngine, ent) -> this+0x70 (used by iffacing/ifclear/tell player), then: entered -> ScriptActor::FireEvent(actor, "touch") inside -> ScriptActor::FireEvent(actor, "touching") left -> ScriptActor::FireEvent(actor, "untouch") actor = embedded TScriptActor at this+0x24. Loop breaks early if a script ran the `break` verb (sets this+0x74). BoundsTrigger::Spawn hard-binds "touch" -> "tell player escape" by default; editor key/values (this+0xfc slots +0x10..+0x34, up to 10) are pushed as script lines via ScriptTrigger::AddScriptLine.

FUNCTION.NAME: ScriptTrigger::HandleVerb
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
ScriptTrigger::HandleVerb (TScriptTrigger vtable slot 1). The level-script command set. Reached from ScriptActor::ExecCommand via (*(*this+4))() AFTER ScriptActor::HandleBaseVerb declines the token. Hand-written stricmp/String::EqualsIgnoreCase if-chain, NO {name,fnptr} table. Per verb it loops the parsed arg rows (this[7]=row count, ScriptParser::GetArg) and calls one dedicated Verb_* worker per row. Token helpers: FUN_0040c330 get String, FUN_0040c360 EqualsIgnoreCase, FUN_0040cd50 String->int, FUN_0040cc50 String->float.
VERB CATALOG (worker = ScriptTrigger::Verb_<Name>): help; tell/action <actor> <cmd> (re-enter ExecCommand on another actor); break (this[0x74]=1 debug); if/ifnot <var> <val> "<cmd>" (string eq); if< if<= if> if>= <var> <N> "<cmd>" (numeric); iffacing/ifnotfacing <e1> <e2> <angTol> "<cmd>"; ifclear/ifnotclear <zone> "<cmd>" (zone occupant count); set <var> <val>; inc/dec <var>; print <var>; once "<cmd>" (per-trigger dedup map this+0x54); ignore <N> "<cmd>" (skip first N hits, per-trigger counter); exec/execsetsonly <script> (LoadScriptFile flag 0/1; flag1 = process only `set` lines); sendmsg <actor> <event> (ScriptActor::FireEvent); playsnd/playsndat/stopsnd/loopsnd/loopsndat/loopsndatloc/ambientsnd + testloopsnd/testambientsnd; hint <sec> "<text>" (-> actor "Player" PlayerRescueEnt::Verb_Hint); fogenable <5 floats>/fogdisable/quake <int> <dur> (atmosphere entity, ent+0x18==5); loadmap/loadhosemap/listmaps/setlighttable/listvars (already named); difficulty easy|med|hard|show ((g+0x6e4)->+0x2c = 0/1/2, writes var "Difficulty"); quit (SHUTS GAME DOWN, not end-level); debugvictims; runrescuebot (RescueBot::TryStartRescue).
NO spawn/goto/label/endlevel/camera verb here -- those are Verb_* on OTHER actors (PlayerRescueEnt::Verb_FinalExit/Escape/AddBonus/Reset...) reached via `tell <actor> <verb>`. Base verbs handled first by ScriptActor::HandleBaseVerb: que/flush/wait <ms>/idle/cmd/loopinque/onmsg/onmsgappend/printmsgs.

FUNCTION.NAME: ParticleSystem::Emit
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ParticleSystem::Emit(this, ownerXform, bForce) -- ONE burst of particles. The engine-wide "spawn effect" call (~9+ callers: tools, MiscEmitter impls, fire). Gated by (now <= this+0x34) unless bForce. Samples an int count in [this+0x38, this+0x3c]; per particle: sample a velocity vec in the box [+0x48..+0x50 min, +0x54..+0x5c max], rotate it into world by ownerXform (Xform_RotateVec), ParticlePool::AllocParticle at the owner origin, then set vel(+0x7c) = rotated sample, accel(+0x88) = this+0x78..+0x80 (constant world accel = gravity/buoyancy), damping = (|vx|,0,|vz|) (horizontal self-damps, vertical does not -> rising, spreading plume), size = Rand_FloatRange(+0x68,+0x6c) * (+0x70), life = Rand_FloatRange(+0x60,+0x64), texture = +0x74. All particles spawn at a POINT; spread comes only from velocity. Then re-arm +0x34 = ftol(Rand_FloatRange(+0x40,+0x44)) (burst interval). ParticleSystem (0x84) extends ParticlePool (ctor 0x00480260): +0x10 SArray<ParticleEmitter*>, +0x28 RenderManager*, +0x2c prototype ParticleNode*, +0x30 cap (-1 = unbounded). Per-frame: the RenderManager calls vtbl slot 1 (ParticlePool::TickAndRenderParticles @0x0047fea0, was "RenderChildren") which ticks + draws every particle via ParticleNode::Render (AdvanceSpawn ramp walk + IntegrateMotion semi-implicit Euler + geWorld_AddPolyOnce quad). flags&8 on a particle = one-shot (freed on ramp wrap). There is NO decal pool -- "decals" are a single persistent ParticleNode per tool repositioned onto the hit surface each frame.

FUNCTION.NAME: File_LoadObfuscatedU32Blob
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: File_LoadObfuscatedU32Blob -- COPY PROTECTION, not asset loading. Resolves a path relative to the EXE's own directory (GetModuleFileNameA + strip the last backslash, unless the path contains ':' or leads with a double-backslash), opens read-only, requires size >= 4 and size % 4 == 0, reads the whole file into the caller buffer, stores the u32 word count at buf[0], and XOR-decrypts the remainder via XorDecryptBuffer (0x00480590, 400-byte repeating key at DAT_004ff948). Sole caller = the undefined function at ~0x00445520 (CheckGameCD): OutputDebugStringA("Don't blame Mekada"), File_LoadObfuscatedU32Blob(&buf, "texture.dat"), checks two payload bytes ('V' and '.'), returns a 2-bit-masked bool -- a disc/CD-presence check. "texture.dat" is a mis-named protection token file, not a texture.

FUNCTION.NAME: Damp_RateFromFraction
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Damp_RateFromFraction. rate = -ln2 / (refRate * ln(frac)), chosen so pow(0.5, dt/rate) == frac^(refRate*dt). Guards: frac <= ~1e-9 -> 1e-5; frac >= ~1.0 -> clamp. Player movement calls it with refRate = 27.0 and frac = 0.2 (grounded/climb/spectator) or 0.95 (airborne). NOTE: the Ghidra decompiled C for this function is WRONG -- it mis-renders the x87 FYL2X instruction.

FUNCTION.NAME: Vec3_DampToward
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: Vec3_DampToward (the velocity blend). t = pow(0.5, g_frameDeltaTime / rate); out = target*(1-t) + current*t. With rate from Damp_RateFromFraction this is t = frac^(27*dt): t = fraction of CURRENT retained, (1-t) = fraction of TARGET adopted; a true dt-corrected exponential (frame-rate independent). It is a convex LERP -- there is NO dot(current,targetDir) projection term, so |out| can never exceed max(|current|, |target|). Args (dest, current, target, rate); rate passed on the x87 stack.

FUNCTION.NAME: MapZoneManager::RebuildZoneOccupants
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: MapZoneManager::RebuildZoneOccupants -- per-frame (from PlayerRescueEnt::UpdateZonesAndWin). Pass 1: EntityIter over all MapZone nodes, SArrayPtr::SetCount(zone+0x20, 0) -- clear occupant lists. Pass 2: global entity iter; for each entity with type tag ent[6]==2 (victim) AND state ent[0x48] not in {5,6} (not rescued/safe): get origin via vtbl+0x18 -> +0x28, MapZoneManager::FindZoneContainingPoint (smallest-volume containing zone wins). No containing zone -> GenErr "TMapZoneManager: ERROR Victim \"...\" is not located in any zone!" (MapZone.cpp:57). Else append to zone+0x20, count zone+0x24. A MapZone is a NAMED SET of BoundsTrigger AABBs (built at load by BoundsTrigger::MakeZone -> MapZoneSet::AddTriggerToNamedZone); zone+0x04 = summed box volume (overlap tiebreak). Fire entities are NEVER added to zones.

NO priority field, NO interrupt arbitration, NO global cooldown -- a new line just plays over/after the last. Debounce = clip-level anti-repeat + Update() re-checking "still playing" only ~once/1000 ticks (+0x1c gate). WorldEntity also has UpdateBoundsCache2 @0x0049d7f0 (slot 4) caching a second bounds vec3 at +0x9c.

Hull mins.Y=-30 (constant) therefore gives an exact origin-to-feet offset: feet.Y = entity+0x50 - 30, for both standing and crouched hull.

FUNCTION.NAME: ModelEntity::SnapToFloor
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
ModelEntity::SnapToFloor. pos.y += 48; swept (0,-1000,0) trace. On MISS: GenErr severity 2 = NON-FATAL (Console::Print in devMode, silent in retail, "cannot find floor!"); zero-init out-params are never written, so the caller ends up with pos = (0,1,0) = WORLD ORIGIN (not a crash). Player path: PlayerRescueEnt::ResetLocomotionState (respawn/reset) only -- NOT jump/crouch/escape/movement.
CONFIRMED BUG (player-stuck cycle, verified independently twice via decompile+disasm): on a ROCRender::TraceToFloor 0x00492ce0 MISS, the out-params are never written (TraceToFloor's own early-return at 0x00492dab/0x00492cfc skips all output writes) -- but SnapToFloor unconditionally commits its explicitly-zeroed stack locals (MOV [ESP+..],0 at 0x0049da3d-0x0049da65) to entity position anyway, +1.0 to Y. Net effect on miss: entity teleports to world origin (0.0, 1.0, 0.0). The only hit/miss-gated branch (0x0049dab1) controls a non-fatal GenErr log, NOT the position write. Reachable for the player only via ResetLocomotionState 0x0044cd10 (Verb_Reset/OnLevelWon) -- never during ordinary per-frame movement. Also used by victim placement (WarpToRescuerAndFade/DropAtPlayer/SpawnAtSpot) where the same bug applies if the target spot has no floor beneath it.

FUNCTION.NAME: Entity::IntegrateVelocity
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT:
PlayerRescueEnt movement fields (entity-relative; base sub-object at off 0): velocity xyz = +0xfc/+0x100/+0x104 (u/s); acceleration xyz = +0x108/+0x10c/+0x110 (Think sets .y=-1000 gravity per frame); per-frame move-delta disp = +0x90/+0x94/+0x98 (= v*dt + 0.5*a*dt^2); per-axis linear drag = +0x114/+0x118/+0x11c; prev-frame velocity = +0xf0/+0xf4/+0xf8; prev-accel snapshot +0x120... . Also copies onground: +0x12d = +0x12c ; +0x12c = 0 each frame (one coyote frame).
--- cluster-1 update: __thiscall(ECX=entity base). Semi-implicit Euler for 1 frame. (1) per-axis linear drag toward 0 using coeff entity+0x114/0x118/0x11c (Think writes {1000,0,1000} grounded / {0,0,0} air / {1000,1000,1000} climb-spectator each frame), clamped so it cannot cross zero. (2) vel(entity+0xfc/0x100/0x104) += accel(entity+0x108/0x10c/0x110)*g_frameDeltaTime (Think sets accel.y=-1000 gravity, 0 for climb/spectator). (3) frame displacement entity+0x90/0x94/0x98 = vel_new*dt + 0.5*accel*dt^2. (4) snapshot prev vel entity+0xf0.. and prev accel entity+0x120... (5) entity+0x12d = entity+0x12c ; entity+0x12c = 0 (one coyote frame). Does NOT touch position or call collision.

FUNCTION.NAME: ModelEntity::ClipVelocityToPlanes
FUNCTION.REGULAR_CMT: ModelEntity::ClipVelocityToPlanes. Sets the grounded flag when contact plane normal.Y >= 0.5 (<=60deg walkable slope). Displacement is recomputed after.
